author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೇಹ ನಶ್ವರವಿರಲು ಮಮಕಾರ ನಿನಗೇಕೆ
ಮೋಹವಿರೆ ಕತ್ತಲಲಿ ಬದುಕುವೆಯೊ ನೀನು
ನೇಹದಿಂದಲಿ ಕಾಣೆ ಜಗವೆಂದು ಸುಂದರವು
ಗೇಹವನೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಿಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When the body is perishable, why this attachment?
if you cling to it, you will live in darkness;
seen with affection, the world is always beautiful;
keep your true home ready, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The body will not last, so clinging to it keeps us in darkness. Look at the world with love, and prepare for the lasting home beyond it.
